lines.t: Sunlight slipping through a canopy,
Gold running down every trembling leaf.
Nothing to sell, nothing to prove,
Just a thousand branches letting daylight through.
Wind comes rolling where the tall grass grows,
Bending every blade in a long, green row.
An ordinary field by an old fence line,
Turns into wonder in the morning light.
No flashing sign, no crowded street,
Just a little wildflower at tired feet.
So much glory in the smallest things
Everywhere, a reason to sing.
Look around, look around,
There’s a little bit of heaven touching down.
From an eagle riding high
To a flower on the ground.
Every leaf, every breeze,
Every color underneath these clouds
The hand of God is plain to see,
Look around, look around.
Oh-oh, in the sky and the ground,
Oh-oh, His splendor all around.
Look around, look around.
An eagle circles where the blue runs deep,
Over all the worries that the townsfolk keep.
No painted ceiling, no velvet rope,
Just an open sky and a little room for hope.
Down where the gravel meets the roadside green,
A tiny bloom that almost goes unseen.
Petals so fragile, a stem so small,
Still bearing witness to the Lord of all.
No need to travel a thousand miles,
There’s wonder growing where the road runs wild.
From the highest wing to the smallest seed,
His creation carries a melody.
Look around, look around,
There’s a little bit of heaven touching down.
From an eagle riding high
To a flower on the ground.
Every leaf, every breeze,
Every color underneath these clouds
The hand of God is plain to see,
Look around, look around.
The grass bends low as the wind rolls through,
A silver-green wave beneath the blue.
The eagle fades to a distant speck,
A flower leans by the old porch step.
Far beyond reach, close enough to touch
His splendor shines in both so much.
Let the hurry settle down…
Look around.
Look around, look around,
There’s a little bit of heaven touching down.
From an eagle riding high
To a flower on the ground.
Every leaf, every breeze,
Every color underneath these clouds
The hand of God is plain to see,
From the mountains to this patch of green.
Let the wonder slow the whole world
Look around, look around.
Written in the leaves,
Carried on the breeze,
Soaring high above,
Blooming right beneath…
Oh-oh, His splendor all around.
Look around.
